description: Microsoft long-form speech-to-text model that processes up to 60 minutes of audio in one pass and produces structured transcripts with speakers, timestamps, content, hotwords, and 50+ language support.

request.name: language
request.description: Optional transcript language label; VibeVoice-ASR can auto-detect language and handle code-switching without an explicit language setting.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Sampling temperature; default 0 uses deterministic decoding.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Top-k sampling limit; default 50, 0 disables top-k filtering.

request.name: num_beams
request.description: Beam count for deterministic beam search; default 1.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Generation repetition penalty; must be positive, default 1.0.

request.name: seed
request.description: Acoustic latent sampling seed for reproducible output; default 1234.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: Audio chunking mode; default auto uses fixed chunks.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Audio chunk duration in seconds for fixed and VAD chunking; must be positive, default 1200.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Tokenizer, connector, and decoder weight storage type; default native.

session.name: tokenizer_weight_type
session.description: Speech tokenizer weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: connector_weight_type
session.description: Acoustic and semantic connector weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: decoder_weight_type
session.description: Text decoder weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: tokenizer_weight_context_mb
session.description: Speech tokenizer weight context arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: connector_weight_context_mb
session.description: Acoustic and semantic connector weight context arena size in MiB; default 128.

session.name: decoder_weight_context_mb
session.description: Text decoder weight context arena size in MiB; default 4096.

session.name: vad_path
session.description: Silero VAD model path used by audio_chunk_mode=vad.
